name: Agent baseline
summary: Install the approved agents of a software baseline set (monitoring, EDR, patching, backup) in a VM.
description: Runs inside the guest through VMware Tools (no WinRM / SSH). Installs only the packages of the set that are Approved in the software repository (Admin > Data files > software); Pending or Retired packages are skipped and listed in the result. Each package is verified before and after installation, so a re-run only installs what is missing.

inputs.name: VMName
inputs.label: Virtual machine
inputs.help: Powered-on VM with VMware Tools running.

inputs.name: BaselineSet
inputs.label: Baseline set
inputs.help: Must match the guest OS (Windows or Linux set).

inputs.name: GuestCredential
inputs.label: Guest administrator credential
inputs.help: Windows: local administrator (domain account to read UNC sources). Linux: root or a user with passwordless sudo.
